data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by tool failures (HTTP 400 and parsing errors) when auditing the .SRCINFO file in two of the models, rather than any actual security concerns. learnings: The audit tool should fast-path or skip .SRCINFO files, as they are purely declarative metadata generated from the PKGBUILD and contain no executable code. This prevents unnecessary LLM calls and parsing errors.
